symptom: A host candidate build and signed resolution succeeded, but vNext release always dialed the signed Operator endpoint and could not use the restricted loopback tunnel required by the CI network boundary.
whyGateMissed: The release path verified signed Operator identity but had no regression case for preserving that identity while routing the protocol through an Operator-owned CI transport adapter.
earliestDetection: Exercise vNext release transport selection with an execute-mode CI override and require loopback-only routing while remote, credential-bearing, and non-CI overrides fail closed.
